This small plot near my home is only 0.11 hectares, but maize is our food so I must care for it well. Here in Iringa the rains come, so I do not need to irrigate — God gives us water from the sky. I will put a little DAP at planting and top-dress with urea if I can afford it, and I always spread manure from my cattle because it keeps the soil strong. I use improved seed from the agrodealer in town because fall armyworm has been bad, and I will spray when I see the worms in the funnel of the maize. Since the plot is small and close to the house, my wife and children and I can manage most of the work ourselves; I only hire a few people for weeding when the rains are heavy and the weeds grow fast.
